name: dsh-markji-bridge
description: Give a DSH agent Markji (maimemo) cards through four consolidated tools: decks and chapters, card reads/writes/syntax/archive/move, sync/state/failures/conflict resolution, and uncached file upload/query. Local SQLite cache with inline content, formatting-insensitive plain-text search, queued batch edits (including cross-chapter / cross-deck creation), raw Markji syntax validation and media preflight, remote-deletion detection, background sync with crash-resume, 3-way merge and conflict recovery.
author: Muluo
